notes.title: Lucie's Potager 0.6.3 Update
notes.content:
Firstly we'd like to say a big thanks to everyone that played the demo over the past few weeks!

We've found a bunch of things to improve thanks to you, so we've decided to update the demo with a few fixes to make it a more enjoyable experience.

Fixes

 Corrected "Potager" typo in tutorial
 Fixed bugs that caused certain upgrades to not work correctly
 Fixed Alfred's customer sprite not having an outline
 Corrected a town name
 Updated bushes and grass
 Updated controls for the Encyclopedia
 Fixed map nodes not appearing as unlocked


Changes

 Increased hitbox of Collection points
 Reduced size of the Shop and Workshop
 Changed layout of the Garden and Town
 Updated tutorials
 Oil Quest doesn't become active until Bulb Quest is finished
 Removed watering mechanic/UI
 Customers leave the store faster when not interested in items
 Shop bench can be used while shop is open to force the shop to close early
